feature: Go doc comments read by whole line
description: When finding a Go export's doc comment, a line of source is read whole: comments after code on a line belong to that code, and a line holding only comments is one line of the doc comment.

specs.description: A tag in the second of two comments after code does not tag the next spec
specs.given: A Go file holding `const (`, then `A = 1 /* x */ // @hexa:public`, then `B = 2`, then `)`, with no other comments
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `B` has hexa_public false

specs.description: Three comments after code all belong to that code's line
specs.given: A Go file whose line 3 is `var A = 1 /* x */ /* y */ // @hexa:public` and whose line 4 is `func F() {}`, with no other comments
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public false

specs.description: A tag in the first of two comments after code does not tag what follows
specs.given: A Go file holding `const (`, then `A = 1 /* @hexa:public */ /* y */`, then `B = 2`, then `)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `B` has hexa_public false

specs.description: A line of code with comments breaks the doc run of the declaration below it, so a tag above that line does not pass through
specs.given: A Go file holding `const (`, then `// @hexa:public`, then `X = 1 /* a */ // b`, then `Y = 2`, then `)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `Y` has hexa_public false

specs.description: Code on an earlier line does not make a comment on its own line a line comment
specs.given: A Go file holding `const (`, then `A = 1`, then `// @hexa:public` on a line of its own, then `B = 2`, then `)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `B` has hexa_public true

specs.description: Comments after code on a line never tag the declaration on the next line, whatever their number or kind
specs.given: Any Go file where line L holds code followed by n ≥ 1 comments, each `/* … */` or a final `// …`, at least one containing `@hexa:public`, line L+1 declares an exported name D, and D has no other comments above it
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named D has hexa_public false

specs.description: A comment-only line of two comments, tag in the first, tags the function below
specs.given: A Go file whose line 3 is `/* @hexa:public */ // note` and whose line 4 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public true

specs.description: A comment-only line of two comments, tag in the second, tags the function below
specs.given: A Go file whose line 3 is `/* note */ // @hexa:public` and whose line 4 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public true

specs.description: A line of two comments counts as one line, so the run continues to the line above it
specs.given: A Go file whose line 2 is `// @hexa:public`, line 3 is `/* a */ /* b */`, and line 4 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public true

specs.description: A blank line between a comment-only line and the declaration still ends the run
specs.given: A Go file whose line 3 is `/* @hexa:public */ // note`, line 4 is blank, and line 5 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public false

specs.description: A blank line above a line of several comments ends the run there
specs.given: A Go file whose line 2 is `// @hexa:public`, line 3 is blank, line 4 is `/* a */ // b`, and line 5 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public false

specs.description: A comment-only line of several comments, none carrying the tag, does not tag
specs.given: A Go file whose line 3 is `/* a */ /* b */ // c` and whose line 4 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public false

specs.description: On a comment-only line directly above a declaration, the tag is read whatever the position and number of the comments
specs.given: Any Go file where line L holds only k ≥ 1 comments, each `/* … */` or a final `// …`, line L+1 is `func F() {}`, and there are no other comments in the file
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public true exactly when at least one of the k comments contains `@hexa:public`

specs.description: A one-comment-per-line doc comment still tags
specs.given: A Go file whose line 2 is `// Package docs`, line 3 is `// @hexa:public`, and line 4 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public true

specs.description: A group's doc comment still covers its specs
specs.given: A Go file holding `// @hexa:public`, then `const (`, then `A = 1`, then `B = 2`, then `)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclarations named `A` and `B` both have hexa_public true

specs.description: Another language reads the tag as before
specs.given: A Rust file holding `/// @hexa:public` directly above `pub fn f() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Rust
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `f` has hexa_public true

specs.description: A blank line still ends a one-comment-per-line run
specs.given: A Go file whose line 2 is `// @hexa:public`, line 3 is blank, and line 4 is `func F() {}`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `F` has hexa_public false

specs.description: A single line comment after code still does not tag the next spec
specs.given: A Go file holding `const (`, then `A = 1 // @hexa:public`, then `B = 2`, then `)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: the ExportDeclaration named `B` has hexa_public false

specs.description: Where every comment is alone on its line, the tag is read from the unbroken run of comment lines directly above
specs.given: Any Go file of top-level `func` declarations in which every comment is a `//` comment alone on its own line, separated by any mix of blank lines
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: each function's ExportDeclaration has hexa_public true exactly when some comment in the unbroken run of comment lines ending on the line directly above it contains `@hexa:public`
